job.title: Organisational Effectiveness Lead
job.description:
About Them
The Australian Football League (AFL) is one of Australia's most recognised and influential sporting organisations, connecting communities through a shared passion for Australia's game. With approximately 1,000 employees and 3,000 casual workers across a growing and increasingly complex organisation, the AFL is investing in its people capability to support future growth, performance and organisational effectiveness. 
 
About the Role
This newly created role represents a rare opportunity to shape the future of organisational effectiveness at one of Australia's most iconic brands.
Reporting to the Executive General Manager People, you will lead the design and delivery of key people initiatives that strengthen organisational capability, workforce performance and employee experience. Operating as a trusted adviser and strategic partner, you'll combine big-picture thinking with hands-on delivery across a broad organisational development portfolio. 

Key priorities include:
  • Strategic workforce planning and organisational capability
  • Future of work and ways of working initiatives
  • Culture and engagement strategy
  • Performance framework enhancement
  • Organisation-wide people projects and change initiatives
  • Contributing to the development and driving execution of the AFL People Plan
This is not a role for someone who wants to simply advise from the sidelines. You'll have the opportunity to identify opportunities, design practical solutions and see them through to implementation in a fast-moving, highly ambitious environment.
 
About Success
Success in the first 12 months will look like:
  • Establishing a practical and scalable workforce planning approach
  • Enhancing the AFL's performance culture and performance frameworks
  • Driving meaningful improvements in ways of working and organisational effectiveness
  • Bringing engagement and culture insights to life through tangible action plans
  • Building credibility as a trusted partner to leaders across the business
  • Delivering high-impact outcomes at pace, without unnecessary complexity
You'll be known for balancing strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and delivering solutions that genuinely improve business outcomes.
 
About You
You are an experienced Organisational Development, Organisational Effectiveness or People professional who thrives in high-performance environments.

To succeed, you'll bring:
  • Proven Organisational Development professional with experience leading workforce planning, culture, performance or organisational effectiveness initiatives
  • Strong project and change leadership capability
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to connect people initiatives to business outcomes
  • A practical, solutions-focused mindset
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills
  • The confidence to challenge thinking and introduce fresh ideas
  • High levels of resilience, adaptability and personal accountability
Importantly, you'll know what good looks like and be able to adapt leading practice to fit a fast-paced, resource-conscious environment.
 
About Culture & Benefits
As a values-led organisation built on Play to Win, Play as One Team, Play with Passion and Play Fair, the AFL is committed to creating a high-performing culture where people can thrive and make a meaningful impact.

The AFL offers a culture unlike any other. You'll join a highly capable and collaborative People team that values initiative, innovation and delivery. This is an environment where great ideas are welcomed, bureaucracy is limited and leaders are genuinely open to new thinking.
In return, you'll enjoy:
  • A newly created role with significant organisational impact
  • Exposure to executive leaders and enterprise-wide initiatives
  • The opportunity to shape the future workforce of the AFL
  • A values-driven, high-performance culture
  • Flexibility and autonomy
  • Working within one of Australia's most recognised and respected brands
  • A collegiate team that enjoys challenging ideas, moving quickly and delivering outcomes
For an Organisational Development professional seeking breadth, influence and the opportunity to create meaningful change, few opportunities offer this level of exposure and impact.

job.title: People & Culture Business Partner

Working closely with senior leaders and as part of a national People & Culture function, you will act as the key P&C contact for the South Australian business, balancing strategic partnering with the delivery of pragmatic, commercially focused HR solutions.

The environment is fast-paced and operational, so this opportunity will suit someone who enjoys being close to the business, building credibility with leaders and employees, and taking ownership rather than operating within a highly segmented HR model.

The Role
Partnering with leaders across the business, you will provide advice, coaching and support across a diverse range of people matters. You will build trusted stakeholder relationships and help strengthen leadership capability while ensuring national people initiatives are effectively embedded locally.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing operational HR advice and coaching to leaders across the employee lifecycle.
  • Managing complex employee and industrial relations matters, including workplace investigations and performance issues.
  • Playing an active role in enterprise bargaining, including preparation, stakeholder engagement, and implementation.
  • Supporting workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding and retention strategies.
  • Coaching leaders on performance management, development and effective people leadership.
  • Supporting organisational change and transformation initiatives.
  • Providing guidance on employment legislation, industrial instruments, policies and procedures.
  • Contributing to the development and implementation of broader national People & Culture projects and initiatives.
  • Using workforce insights and data to identify trends and support better people and business decisions.
About You
You will be an experienced HR generalist who is comfortable operating autonomously and can move confidently between strategic conversations and hands-on employee matters.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • 3+ years' experience in an HR Business Partner or comparable generalist HR position.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Human Resources, Business Management or a related discipline.
  • Sound knowledge of Australian employment legislation, workplace relations and contemporary HR practices.
  • Practical experience managing employee relations and industrial relations matters.
  • The confidence to coach and influence leaders at different levels of an organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and relationship-building capability.
  • The ability to navigate change, ambiguity and sensitive workplace matters with sound judgement.
  • A commercial and pragmatic approach, with the ability to use data and insights to inform decisions.
  • The ability to work independently while remaining closely connected to a broader national HR team.
Experience within transport, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing, infrastructure, engineering or another operational/industrial environment would be particularly valuable.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional looking for genuine ownership and breadth. Rather than specialising in one area of HR, you will work closely with the business across the full spectrum of people matters, while having access to the expertise and support of a national P&C function.

You will have the opportunity to guide and influence leaders, navigate ER/IR matters, contribute to enterprise bargaining and change initiatives, and help shape the people agenda within the South Australian operation.

If you enjoy being visible in the business, building trusted relationships and delivering practical HR solutions, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact.
